page.overview:
Who is Business Baby?

Business Baby is a minor character in Invincible. He is one of the superheroes who would fight during the Invincible War.

Business Baby has the appearance of a young toddler with tan hair and grayish eyes.

True to his name, Business Baby wears a business suit fitting for his stature. It consists of a black coat over a white shirt with a black tie. He also wears black shorts and shoes with white socks.

Business Baby's background is largely unknown save for the fact that he is a superhero.
